File storage

Cloud record here, video files on your SSD

Content OS stores episode details, prompt revisions, production packs, reviews and analytics as one canonical cloud record. It does not create duplicate local files automatically. Download the single final HTML only when you want an offline filming copy; original footage and final exports remain in your existing SSD folders.

Write and review

Prepare your script

Read the saved script here before approving it. Importing a result does not approve or lock it.

Show me how — prepare or change my script
  1. Select your episode below. Follow its next-action message.
  2. No script yet? Copy the request to Codex, then return its complete answer through Save generated result.
  3. Have a script? Read it below. Use the complete-script editor to change it in one place, then save for recheck.
  4. Approve only the checked version you want to film. Open Script & HTML for your filming copy.

Already recorded? Use Audit video instead; do not rewrite the recording to satisfy a pre-film check.

Script & HTML

Imported scripts and filming sheets persist in the episode record. HTML is generated from that saved version when you download it; no HTML file is automatically placed in a folder. Unapproved downloads are labelled DRAFT.

Open imported content to see its script or slides, preparation list, exact actions, visual direction and edit notes.

Audit and log

Audit video

Audit the edited export in Codex, then save the review here. After uploading, record the post link. Analytics are follow-up records, not extra creation steps.

Record published post

Get your edited video audited

You can audit an existing video even if you did not create it here. No episode record is needed to start.

Copy the request, then attach your video in Codex or give its local file path.

In Codex, attach your final video or give its local file path and ask: “Audit this APC video before upload. Give timestamped blockers, optional polish and a final READY or NOT READY decision.” Keep the video on your device.

This page does not inspect or upload your video. Audit requests run in Codex; only a validated review manifest is saved here. Saving a review requires the existing filming-pack checks. For a historical upload without an export, use “Record an already-published video” below; that does not approve a video review.

Paste the review manifest returned after a full, delta or final video audit. The video SHA-256 prevents findings from an older export being mistaken for the latest cut.
